title: Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統
titleEn: Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system
summary: 以光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼解析Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system through sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 依公開研究與裝置資料編寫的離線模型、編譯及證據判讀。不是實機組裝、雷射或低溫作業SOP；假想算例不代表廠商精度、量子優勢或容錯能力。研發宣稱與已驗證觀測分開標示。
scopeEn: Offline models, compilation and evidence interpretation from public research/device sources. Not hardware assembly, laser/cryogenic SOPs; assumed examples are not vendor fidelity, advantage or fault tolerance. Development claims and demonstrated observations remain distinct.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統案例中比較光子與時間模式與擠壓態與PNR條件資源，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate photons and time modes and squeezed states/pnr-heralded resources within the Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system case.

steps.title: 光子編碼與模式：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Photonic encoding and modes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對光子與時間模式提出可反駁的光子編碼與模式模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable photonic encoding and modes model and evidence record for photons and time modes.
steps.instruction: 在「Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識光子與時間模式。路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。 建立光子編碼與模式的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify photons and time modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system. Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of photonic encoding and modes, focusing on sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Map encodings, modes and measurements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有光子模式都可無條件計為容錯邏輯位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every optical mode counts unconditionally as a fault-tolerant logical qubit.
steps.check: 提交光子與時間模式的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for photons and time modes.

knowledge.title: 光子編碼與模式
knowledge.text: 路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。 本課架構對應：光子與時間模式

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有光子模式都可無條件計為容錯邏輯位元。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Map encodings, modes and measurements. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every optical mode counts unconditionally as a fault-tolerant logical qubit.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 7 段光路各透過率 0.89，獨立串接成功率為 0.89^7=0.442313；總損耗 3.5427 dB。未含光源、偵測器及糾纏閘失敗，不能當作容錯閾值。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 7 segments each transmit 0.89: cascaded success 0.89^7=0.442313, loss 3.5427 dB. Sources, detectors and entangling-gate failure are excluded; this is not a fault-tolerance threshold.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統」的「光子編碼與模式：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「量子實驗值班：證據有多準」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Photonic encoding and modes: architecture analysis” in “Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Quantum Experiment Shift: How Precise Is the Evidence” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就光子與時間模式的「光子編碼與模式」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for photonic encoding and modes in photons and time modes?
options: 路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。
所有光子模式都可無條件計為容錯邏輯位元。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts.
Every optical mode counts unconditionally as a fault-tolerant logical qubit.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。 畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。
quiz.explanationEn: Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts. Map encodings, modes and measurements.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「光子編碼與模式」模型，檢查光子與時間模式的兩個假想案例。畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous photonic encoding and modes model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving photons and time modes. Map encodings, modes and measurements. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.instruction: 在「Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識擠壓態與PNR條件資源。Aurora使用擠壓光學資源與PNR条件量測產生非高斯資源；不能直接等同PsiQuantum的單光子來源路線。 建立擠壓態與條件資源的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫高斯來源、條件事件與資源供應的層次，分開機率與光路損耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify squeezed states/pnr-heralded resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system. Aurora uses squeezed optical resources and PNR-conditioned preparation of non-Gaussian resources, distinct from PsiQuantum’s single-photon route. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of squeezed states and heralded resources, focusing on sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Gaussian sources, heralding events and resource supply, with probability/loss distinct. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
